description: This file defines the LabelInfo class, which manages label keys, comments, associated file names, and localized label values within the Apache OFBiz framework's web tools label manager module.

classes.name: LabelInfo
classes.description: Manages label keys, comments, file names, and localized label values, providing methods to get/set label information and handle multiple locales.

methods.name: LabelInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing label key, comment, filename, locale, label value, and comment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the label.

methods.name: getLabelValue
methods.description: Retrieves the label value for a specific locale.

methods.name: getLabelValueSize
methods.description: Returns the number of localized label values.

methods.name: setLabelValue
methods.description: Sets or updates the label value and comment for a specific locale, with optional update flag.
